dct_description_sm: Contributors: Okadaya, Kashichi, active 19th century; Takai, Ranzan, 1762-1838

Cover title. Oriented with north to the right. Wood block print, hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Japanese. Cadastral map showing land ownership. Shows important buildings, family crests, and points of interest. Includes distance chart and day by day listing of events in Tokyo for 1860. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Gift; Mrs. Nelson. T. Johnson, 17 August, 1971. Vault AACR2
